definitions.explanation: Relating to the study of kanji (Chinese characters) in Japanese context, especially for dictionaries organized by kanji.

examples.japanese: {漢和|かんわ}{辞典|じてん}で{漢字|かんじ}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To look up a kanji in a kanji dictionary.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}めない{漢字|かんじ}は{漢和|かんわ}{辞典|じてん}で{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: I check kanji I can't read in a kanji dictionary.

examples.japanese: {漢和|かんわ}{辞典|じてん}には{部首|ぶしゅ}{索引|さくいん}がある。
examples.english: Kanji dictionaries have a radical index.

notes:
USAGE: Primarily used in the term {漢和|かんわ}{辞典|じてん} (kanji dictionary).

KANJI DICTIONARY FEATURES:
・{部首|ぶしゅ}{索引|さくいん} (radical index)
・{総画|そうかく}{索引|さくいん} (stroke count index)
・{音訓|おんくん}{索引|さくいん} (reading index)

HOW IT DIFFERS:
・{漢和|かんわ}{辞典|じてん} - looks up kanji by their components, gives readings and meanings
・{国語|こくご}{辞典|じてん} - looks up words by their reading

NOTE: Essential for learning to read and write kanji, especially for native speakers learning new characters.
